title: Assert GitWatcher handle release with a decisive Git-repository deletion proof
outcome: A Git-backed shutdown regression proves GitWatcher releases its handles rather than relying only on tolerant repository cleanup.
acceptance: A Git-repository variant of the shutdown lifecycle test fails if GitWatcher retains handles on .git or .git/logs
The asserted proof does not replace tolerant cleanup for unrelated Git-tree residue
disposal_reason: Refiled as an independent root per Fable clearance; this pre-existing non-regression coverage gap must not be coupled to the active TEMP-lifecycle parent.
